C-AUDIT-SCORING-V3.IntentSummary: Scoring version 3 in the smart-audit CLI: an aggregate limit of 30 points for medium findings, band caps applied to the overall score, updated calculation rendering and scoring documentation, all under node:test coverage, without touching rubrics, agents, schemas, or the review skill.

T-001.Title: Scoring version 3 core: medium limit and overall caps

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cli/lib/score.mjs raises SCORING_VERSION to 3, caps the total medium deduction at 30 and the total low deduction at 14 per audit, and caps the overall score at 39 when any audit has a counted critical finding and at 69 when any has a counted high finding; counting rules are unchanged.

node:test cases cover: ten mediums deduct exactly 30; the eleventh medium changes nothing; a run of four clean audits plus one audit with a counted critical yields an overall score of at most 39; the same run with a counted high yields at most 69; scoring the same findings twice yields the same score and identical file content.

T-002.Title: Report renders the new limits and caps as calculation steps

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The calculation shown in report.md and report.html names the medium limit and each applied cap as steps, and a node:test asserts the step text for a fixture that triggers all three limits (medium cap, low cap, overall cap).
Comparing runs with different scoring versions emits the version-mismatch note, under a node:test.

T-003.Title: Scoring reference and changelog for version 3

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: reference/scoring.md documents version 3: the formula, the rationale for 30 and for the overall caps, updated band meanings, and a version history entry; existing version-2 expectations in tests are updated, not deleted.
CHANGELOG.md gains an entry describing scoring version 3 and its effect on comparability.
